newsitem.title: USA: ABB unit to modernize Russian refinery.
newsitem.headline: ABB unit to modernize Russian refinery.

text.p: ABB Lummus Global, a unit of ABB Brown Boveri AG, on Tuesday said it was awarded a contract valued at more than $100 million to modernize a petrochemical refinery owned by JSC Nizhnekamskneftekhim (NKNK), one of Russia's largest companies.
The refinery is located at Nizhnekamsk, 1,200 kilometers (750 miles) east of Moscow, in the Russian Republic of Tatartstan.
The order covers the design, engineering and procurement of a middle-distillates hydrotreating complex, including a distribution control system.

The project will be financed in part under a loan guarantee by the Export-Import Bank of the United States, it said. The guarantee is covered by the Oil and Gas Framework Agreement betweem the Russian and U.S. governments, it said.
NKNK produces refined petroleum products, chemicals, petrochemicals and finished consumer products.
ABB Lummus, based in Bloomfield, N.J., is an international engineering and construction unit of the ABB Group.
